web/index.html.name: Page shell
web/index.html.description: The single web page the app loads into, which starts the app.

web/src/App.tsx.name: App screens map
web/src/App.tsx.description: Decides which screen shows for each address, and wraps them in sign-in, session and the update prompt.

web/src/main.tsx.name: App start
web/src/main.tsx.description: Starts the app in the browser once the language is ready.

web/src/pwa/appVersion.ts.name: App version check
web/src/pwa/appVersion.ts.description: Reads which version the live site is on so the app can tell when a newer one is available.

web/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.ts.name: Offline and update helper
web/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.ts.description: Sets up the background helper that lets the app install on a phone and notices when a new version is waiting.

web/src/pwa/UpdatePrompt.tsx.name: New version prompt
web/src/pwa/UpdatePrompt.tsx.description: Shows a "new version is ready" message with a choice to update now or later.

web/src/pwa/updateStore.ts.name: Update status keeper
web/src/pwa/updateStore.ts.description: Remembers whether a new version is waiting and whether its prompt was dismissed, so the menu can bring it back.

web/src/routes/AppLayout.tsx.name: Page frame and menu
web/src/routes/AppLayout.tsx.description: Draws the frame around signed-in screens: a side menu on desktop and bottom tabs on a phone, showing only what the role may reach.

web/src/routes/nav.tsx.name: Menu entries
web/src/routes/nav.tsx.description: Lists the menu destinations, grouped by job and filtered to the person's role, and picks the four phone tabs.
